verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation rules are a fair axis for an AI video SaaS platform, but the evidence shows no native HeyGen feature for defining rules that trigger actions on events. Batch API webhooks [heygen-docs-1] are developer building blocks for building such automation, not a rules capability. The n8n/Make/Zapier integrations [heygen-docs-28] would put rule definition in external tools, and the pack never says HeyGen exposes event triggers to them, so neither earns credit.
